name: Mhaji Bus Scheme
benefit:
- A subsidy of ₹3/- per kilometer operated shall be provided to eligible bus operators under the scheme.
- Bus Insurance Subsidy is provided as 50% reimbursement of the annual insurance premium paid up to a maximum of ₹30,000/-.
- The scheme provides Assistance of ₹10,00,000/- for replacing buses older than 15 years, with new buses having a minimum seating capacity of 27.

_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a private bus operator holding a valid stage carriage permit issued by the competent authority in Goa. - The applicant must be the registered owner of the bus/mini bus in the State of Goa. - The bus to be operated under this scheme must not be older than 15 years from the date of its initial registration. - The applicant must agree to comply with all operational, branding, safety, and service norms specified under this scheme. - The bus must operate for the full month. - If the bus is off the road, prior intimation must be given to the competent authority. ***Relaxation*** - For the initial period of 3 years, buses up to 20 years should be eligible to participate in this scheme. - The bus can be kept for repairs and maintenance for two days only, which should be Saturdays, Sundays, or holidays.
